simple.meaning: מַעֲכָתִי (Maʻăkâthîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Maakathite , or inhabitant of Maakah.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מַעֲכָתִי (H4602) appears 8 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Deuteronomy 3:14, with occurrences in Deuteronomy, Joshua, 2 Samuel, 2 Kings, 1 Chronicles, and 1 more.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַעֲכָתִי (H4602) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מַעֲכָתִי (H4602) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מַעֲכָתִי (Maʻăkâthîy) / H4602 is traced through Deuteronomy 3:14, Joshua 12:5, Joshua 13:11, Joshua 13:13 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
